title: where do you get assets from
author: abdosarmini92
selftext:
ai can handle programming very well, but it struggles at creating art. where do you get yours from? i am talking about:

\- 3d assets
\- 2d assets
\- ui elements
\- sounds

where do you buy them from or where do you generate them?

comments.author: jivenossauro
comments.body: Fab and unity asset store, mostly

comments.author: Blake9712
comments.body:
I mostly make them but these days Claude can make them too. It’s just 2D assets with a crude ish South Park looking layer based art style so it’s fine. I need thousands of assets unfortunately. Opus 5.5 can make some too. Oh and I make them in an asset builder I made when I first started my project. Somehow the asset builder part took me like 3 months so idk if it was worth it yet. 

https://i.redd.it/h3uvy7biimyh1.jpeg

comments.author: DimensionalFukery
comments.body: Opus 5.5 is surprisingly good at 3d modeling these days given a few iterations

comments.author: Templeshooter
comments.body:
For 3d meshes, I ask Claude code to make the low-poly "runescape style" 3d models in blender. It also rigs and animates them. Static objects like furniture, vegetation or architecture are very competitive. It can even find free textures from Poly Haven. This all comes off quite good, you can't even tell those were produced by AI. But tbh its not hard to model runescape stuff manually

For 2d assets, I have a local comfyui setup that Claude code helped me build, with scripts that execute special prompts. I have a command to generate an icon for inventory item from description, a command to generate an icon for character ability. More prompts help deslopify them.

I have not solved UI for now, it's on very placeholder level, I generated some images but they look like slop, unlike my icons. I think I have to make better prompting.

Sounds are also generated by the same comfyui setup with Stable Audio 3, but the quality is meh. I'll replace them with free assets if I ever decide to show my project to people.

comments.author: AntFlat2801
comments.body:
Meshy (3D), Gemini (2D)  
opengameart also has a lot of free assets

comments.author: shuozhe
comments.body:
Played around with free tripo a lot and got a month of max for 16€ or so. Opus/gpt61 sol can do easy shapes, nothing organic.. but are amazing at rigging vs tripo.

Hy3d also gives 20-30 generation every day

replies.author: Klov1233
replies.body: Is it allowed to use stuff from the free versions ?

comments.author: BillyMcDev
comments.body: I have bought assets from Unity Asset Store, Itch io and GameDevMarket. That includes; 3D & 2D art, music, sound effects, and particle systems. I have also paid artists in the past for 2D artwork for some of my published games.

comments.author: shuozhe
comments.body: Tripo nope, at least not for commercial games. Hy3d I think so.. at least Gemini told me that. Get a month and just generate everything you need or perhaps will need

comments.author: Horror-Detective4138
comments.body: I create my 3d assets and sounds with astra
